subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should the Control UI channel-session request be satisfied by the open grouping-by-channel PR, or does it still need explicit separated-channel tabs and a merged cross-channel timeline?
rationale: Current main does not implement the requested modes, and the open adjacent PR changes the likely product shape without being a full closing fix or a merged canonical path.

options.title: Land grouping first, keep this open
options.body: Treat the open session-grouping PR as a partial first step and keep this issue open for any remaining separated-view or merged-timeline semantics after it merges.

options.title: Require a full mode-toggle design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers specify the UX and Gateway contract for separated tabs versus a merged timeline.

options.title: Close after grouping merges
options.body: If maintainers decide channel grouping is the intended product answer, close this issue after the grouping PR lands with a comment explaining that decision.

recommendation.title: Land grouping first, keep this open
recommendation.body: Treat the open session-grouping PR as a partial first step and keep this issue open for any remaining separated-view or merged-timeline semantics after it merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the active adjacent grouping PR and has the strongest recent history across the relevant Control UI session surfaces.
